desc: The Bartlett Dam is a concrete multiple-arch buttress dam on the Verde River, located 50 km northeast of Phoenix, Arizona. fact: It was built between 1936 and 1939 · The dam creates Bartlett Lake and its primary purpose is irrigation water supply · It was named after Bill Bartlett, a government surveyor · It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2017
